title: More with Less: a Large Scale Remote Sensing VLM with a Simple Recipe
abstract: arXiv:2607.15942v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Remote sensing vision-language models are increasingly expected to support open-ended reasoning over Earth Observation data and a variety of tasks. Most recent progress in this area has been driven by remote-sensing-specific architectural designs, often introducing new encoders, alignment modules, or task-specific fusion mechanisms. In this work, we challenge the necessity of such architectural specialization. We show that a generally capable vision-language model can achieve competitive or state-of-the-art performance at challenging remote sensing benchmarks, provided that it is trained at sufficient scale across diverse data and tasks. Our model uses a single language policy that can either answer directly in text or invoke a localization tool for segmentation and grounding. translated_title: 以简驭繁：基于简单配方的大规模遥感视觉语言模型
translated_abstract: 遥感视觉语言模型日益被期望能够支持对地球观测数据的开放式推理以及多种任务。该领域近期的大多数进展都是由遥感专用的架构设计驱动的，通常引入新的编码器、对齐模块或任务特定的融合机制。在这项工作中，我们质疑这种架构专门化的必要性。我们证明，一个具备通用能力的视觉语言模型，只要在足够规模的多样的数据和任务上进行训练，就能在有挑战性的遥感基准上取得有竞争力乃至最先进的性能。我们的模型采用单一的语言策略，既可以直接以文本回答，也可以调用定位工具来执行分割和接地任务。为了训练这种异构行为，我们采用了多任务强化学习框架，并配备涵盖多选题视觉问答、自由格式回答等多种任务的自适应奖励机制。
tldr: 该研究证明无需遥感专用的复杂架构设计，仅通过在大规模多样化数据和任务上训练通用视觉语言模型，并采用带自适应任务奖励的多任务强化学习框架，即可在遥感基准上达到有竞争力或最先进的性能。
en_tdlr: A generally capable vision-language model, trained at sufficient scale across diverse data and tasks with a multi-task reinforcement learning framework, can achieve competitive or state-of-the-art performance on remote sensing benchmarks without remote-sensing-specific architectural designs.
